_comment: Curriculum-alignment roster for the Foothill Semiconductor Processing program evaluation (def foothill-semiconductor-processing-top-094500). One program record — the Certificate of Achievement (COCI 43983) — read against the def's three destination occupations; `columns` labels the block columns by certificate so the TOP's other awards can sit beside it later. `paired_soc` is the certificate's stated purpose (moving wafers through semiconductor processing stages); it is in the def's `socs` by the author's addition, noted there. Readings are saved per program under saved_reports/alignment/ and shared with the SVAMP roster, which cites the same record.

programs.pairing_basis: The certificate's stated purpose: preparing students to move wafers through semiconductor processing stages in a cleanroom. TOP 0945.00 does not reach 51-9141 through the TOP-CIP-SOC crosswalk; the discrepancy is shown, not resolved.
